name: KromiumRenderSurface
summary: Represents an opaque rendering surface provided by native engine, following the Adapter pattern to keep the core API agnostic of UI toolkits.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Attempts to unwrap this generic surface into a platform-specific UI component (e.g. java.awt.Component for Swing/Compose Desktop).

parameters.name: clazz
parameters.description: The Kotlin class type of the expected native component.
